product.name: Laptop Charger Flower Cable (3-Pin)
product.full_name: Universal 3-Pin Flower / Clover-Leaf Power Cable for Laptop Chargers
product.description: Universal 3-pin clover-leaf (also called Mickey Mouse or flower) power cable, connecting a laptop charger brick to the wall socket. Standard C5 connector fits the vast majority of HP, Dell, Lenovo, Toshiba, Asus and other laptop charger adapters that use a 3-prong clover-shaped input. Approximately 1.2m in length, 3-pin Kenya plug. Tested before dispatch.

faqs.question: Will this fit my laptop charger?
faqs.answer: This is a universal 3-pin clover-leaf (C5) cable — it fits the vast majority of laptop charger bricks. If you're unsure, send us a photo of your charger's input socket on WhatsApp and we'll confirm.

faqs.question: Is this the same as the charger brick?
faqs.answer: No — this is just the power cable that connects the charger brick to the wall socket, not the adapter itself.
